description: This source file defines a Mailer class within the OrangeHRM system, implementing the MailerInterface. It wraps Symfony's Mailer component to facilitate sending email messages, encapsulating email transport and message sending functionalities.

classes.name: Mailer
classes.description: A Mailer class that implements the MailerInterface to send email messages using Symfony's Mailer component. It provides a constructor to initialize the mailer with a transport and a method to send messages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the Mailer object by initializing Symfony's Mailer with a provided transport.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a raw email message, optionally with an envelope, using Symfony's Mailer.
